verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a broad, well-structured REST API (with OpenAPI spec, interactive docs, and CLI) covering CI/CD, access control, and workflow automation, strongly supporting API-driven parity with UI actions. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of 100% feature parity between UI and API, and some REST API deprecations/versioning caveats exist. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement guaranteeing full UI/API parity, and independent verification that no UI-only features exist.
